scope:
Fresh native C upmix -> explicit conditional electronics, offline only.

Not an acoustic cabin simulation, live preset, stock recording or sound-quality
acceptance test. No resampling, normalization, path-specific time alignment or
hidden auxiliary music donors. Every output directory must be new.

record.scope: Local native host build and sanitizer tests only; no vehicle, target ARM/QNX build, deploy, or production changes.
record.compiler:
Apple clang version 21.0.0 (clang-2100.1.1.101)
Target: arm64-apple-darwin25.5.0
Thread model: posix
InstalledDir: /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/usr/bin
build_commands: cc -std=c99 -O1 -g -Wall -Wextra -Werror -pedantic -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -fno-omit-frame-pointer -Ihook -DSPA_STEREO_UPMIX_TESTING tests/stereo_upmix_test.c hook/audio/stereo_upmix.c hook/audio/hssr_dsp.c hook/audio/hssr_neon.c -lm -o build/upmix-e2e-20260920/upmix_sanitized

cc -std=c99 -O1 -g -Wall -Wextra -Werror -pedantic -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -fno-omit-frame-pointer -Ihook tests/float_render_test.c hook/audio/stereo_upmix.c hook/audio/hssr_dsp.c hook/audio/hssr_neon.c hook/audio/soundcheck.c -lm -o build/upmix-e2e-20260920/float_sanitized

tests.stdout: stereo_upmix_test: OK (Universal + rear shelf + LFE V2)
OK: float synthesis, analysis invariance, exact bypass, linked headroom, metadata/FLUSH ramps

cli_contract.float_selection: --float-render; internal float synthesis, final output still S16 PCM6 WAV

models.guard_optional: --guard-model; default NULL; CLI does not autoload sibling model

guard.s16: corrected 6x8 input matrix; LFE interval plus linked fallback; sample limit32275
guard.float: linked PCM6 and input matrix8 buses; ceiling -1 dBFS; one final S16 conversion

cli_contract.programme_gain: unity unless explicit Sound Check fixture options
cli_contract.cabin_and_quiet_lfe: off by default; enabling either selects float rendering

caveats: Host uses native AArch64 NEON; not QNX ARMv7 NEON compiler/ABI/FPU equivalence or Krait timing proof.
Renderer runs synchronous inference with NULL external control provider; does not reproduce hook asynchronous worker scheduling, underruns or QSA transport.
Sanitizer tests use synthetic fixtures; e2e music renders remain separately owned by root runner.
Guard is input-matrix/sample-peak policy, not acoustic, true-peak or downstream full-DSP overload guarantee.
README historical sections contain outdated model/surround/LFE/routing details; contract here follows current C/header.

build.note: Local supplied build record, hash-checked; not independent compiler/build attestation.

analysis_contract.windows: simultaneous [0,N) programme and [N,N+T) finite tail, including startup latency
analysis_contract.dry_reference: L/R only, 512-frame delay, same BANK1/scenario; NOT stock
analysis_contract.tail: source padded before fresh C render; finite padding does NOT prove settled DSP
analysis_contract.normalization: none; unity programme gain; no SoundCheck metadata supplied
analysis_contract.reset: fresh C process per track/variant; fresh AmpChain per track/scenario/row
analysis_contract.output: 16 config-order electrical channels, float64 model then FLOAT32 measurement; overs preserved; not19-speaker acoustics
analysis_contract.host_boundary: native host synchronous inference/control_provider NULL; not QNX ARMv7 asynchronous worker/QSA or vehicle bit-exact validation
analysis_contract.delay_boundary: 512 is frontal dry-control convention; scene rear can differ (e.g.576); no universal upmix path-delay claim

float_reference.pcm_contract: 6-channel PCM16; float means internal float synthesis/guard followed by S16 quantization

retain75_bass1.pcm_contract: 6-channel PCM16; float means internal float synthesis/guard followed by S16 quantization
